/* InvoiceMapper.selectWarehouseChargeList : 전자상거래 정산관리 창고료 리스트 조회 */
SELECT A.* ,SUM(A.AP_AMOUNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_AP_AMOUNT ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = A.ENT_CODE AND CODE = A.CD_TYPE_A AND GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE') AS CD_TYPE ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = A.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID_A) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME FROM( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.BOUND) AS BOUND ,MAX(od.BOUND_TYPE) AS BOUND_TYPE ,MAX(od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,MAX(od.CUST_CODE_LV2) AS CUST_CODE_LV2 ,MAX(inv.INVOICE_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE ,MAX(inv.INVOICE_NO) AS INVOICE_NO ,MAX(cost.REGISTER_DATE_TIME) AS REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,MAX(cost.ACCOUNT_CODE) AS ACCOUNT_CODE ,MAX(cost.ACCOUNT_NAME) AS ACCOUNT_NAME ,MAX(cost.SEQ_NO_ID) AS SEQ_NO_ID ,MAX(od.OB_DATE) AS OB_DATE ,MAX(od.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(od.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(od.MRN) AS MRN ,MAX(od.MSN) AS MSN ,MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO ,MAX(od.HSN) AS HSN ,MAX(od.PIECES) AS PIECES ,MAX(od.GWT) AS GWT ,MAX(ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN) AS SE_INSPECTION_YN ,MAX(ad.DROP_YN) AS DROP_YN ,MAX(ad.XRAY_YN) AS XRAY_YN ,MAX(od.INSPECTION_YN) AS INSPECTION_YN ,MAX(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME) AS CONSIGNEE_NAME ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WAHA' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS WAHA_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'INS' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS INS_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WMAIN' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS WMAIN_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN chg.CHG_CODE_SYSTEM = 'WHC_E' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS ETC_COST ,ISNULL(SUM(cost.AP_AMOUNT), 0) AS AP_AMOUNT
,MAX(ad.CARRYIN_DATE) AS CARRYIN_DATE ,MAX(ad.CARRYOUT_DATE) AS CARRYOUT_DATE
,MAX(od.ENT_CODE) AS ENT_CODE ,MAX(od.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE_A ,MAX(cost.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_ID_A ,MAX(cost.AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO) AS AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO ,MAX(cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO) AS AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.REMARKS) AS REMARKS ,MAX(od.DELIVERY_NOTE) AS DELIVERY_NOTE ,MAX(od.TARIFF_REMARKS) AS TARIFF_REMARKS FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_SAS_INVOICE inv ON inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO = cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO
GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO, cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO, cost.ACCOUNT_CODE ) A

/* InvoiceMapper.selectCourierChargeList : 전자상거래 정산관리 택배사 리스트 조회 */
SELECT A.* ,SUM(A.AP_AMOUNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_AP_AMOUNT ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = A.ENT_CODE AND CODE = A.DELIVERY_CODE_A AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_DELIVERY_CODE') AS DELIVERY_NAME ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = A.ENT_CODE AND CODE = A.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE_A AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_PAYMENT_GUBN') AS DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE ,(SELECT TOP 1 DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = A.OD_JOB_NO) AS DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = A.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID_A) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME FROM( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.BOUND) AS BOUND ,MAX(od.BOUND_TYPE) AS BOUND_TYPE ,MAX(od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,MAX(od.CUST_CODE_LV2) AS CUST_CODE_LV2 ,MAX(inv.INVOICE_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE ,MAX(inv.INVOICE_NO) AS INVOICE_NO ,MAX(cost.REGISTER_DATE_TIME) AS REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,MAX(cost.ACCOUNT_CODE) AS ACCOUNT_CODE ,MAX(cost.ACCOUNT_NAME) AS ACCOUNT_NAME ,MAX(cost.SEQ_NO_ID) AS SEQ_NO_ID ,MAX(od.OB_DATE) AS OB_DATE ,MAX(od.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO
,MAX(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME) AS CONSIGNEE_NAME ,MAX(od.PIECES) AS PIECES ,MAX(od.GWT) AS GWT ,MAX(od.COMMODITY_ITEM) AS COMMODITY_ITEM ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DLC' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DLC_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DISLA' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DISLA_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DJU' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DJU_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN chg.CHG_CODE_SYSTEM = 'DLV_E' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DTC_COST
,ISNULL(SUM(cost.AP_AMOUNT), 0) AS AP_AMOUNT ,MAX(od.ENT_CODE) AS ENT_CODE ,MAX(od.DELIVERY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_CODE_A ,MAX(od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE) AS DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE_A ,MAX(cost.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_ID_A ,MAX(cost.AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO) AS AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO ,MAX(cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO) AS AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.REMARKS) AS REMARKS ,MAX(od.DELIVERY_NOTE) AS DELIVERY_NOTE ,MAX(od.TARIFF_REMARKS) AS TARIFF_REMARKS FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_SAS_INVOICE inv ON inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO = cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO
GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO, cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO, cost.ACCOUNT_CODE ) A

/* InvoiceMapper.selectBrokerChargeList : 전자상거래 정산관리 관세사 리스트 조회 */

od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.BOUND) AS BOUND ,MAX(od.BOUND_TYPE) AS BOUND_TYPE ,MAX(od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,MAX(od.CUST_CODE_LV2) AS CUST_CODE_LV2 ,MAX(inv.INVOICE_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE ,MAX(od.COMMODITY_ITEM) AS COMMODITY_ITEM ,MAX(ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN) AS SE_INSPECTION_YN ,MAX(ad.DROP_YN) AS DROP_YN ,MAX(ad.XRAY_YN) AS XRAY_YN ,MAX(od.INSPECTION_YN) AS INSPECTION_YN END) AS TAX_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'CFC' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS CFC_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'QUA' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS QUA_COST 'BRK_E' THEN ISNULL(cost.AP_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS BOT_COST

,MAX(od.ENT_CODE) AS ENT_CODE ,MAX(od.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE_A ,MAX(od.CD_USE_TYPE) AS CD_USE_TYPE_A ,MAX(od.CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE) AS CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE_A ,MAX(cost.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_ID_A ,MAX(cost.AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO) AS AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO ,MAX(cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO) AS AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.REMARKS) AS REMARKS ,MAX(od.DELIVERY_NOTE) AS DELIVERY_NOTE ,MAX(od.TARIFF_REMARKS) AS TARIFF_REMARKS FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_SAS_INVOICE inv ON inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO = cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO
GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO, cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO, cost.ACCOUNT_CODE ) A

,MAX(od.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(od.OB_DATE) AS OB_DATE ,MAX(od.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(od.VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,MAX(od.ORIG_CODE) AS ORIG_CODE ,MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO ,MAX(od.PIECES) AS PIECES ,MAX(od.GWT) AS GWT ,MAX(ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN) AS SE_INSPECTION_YN ,MAX(ad.DROP_YN) AS DROP_YN ,MAX(ad.XRAY_YN) AS XRAY_YN ,MAX(od.INSPECTION_YN) AS INSPECTION_YN ,MAX(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME) AS CONSIGNEE_NAME ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WHF' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS WHF_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WHF' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT_CUR, 0) END) AS WHF_COST_CUR cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WMAIN' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS WMAIN_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DLC' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DLC_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DISLA' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DISLA_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DJU' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DJU_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DTY' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DTY_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'TAX' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS TAX_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'CFC' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS CFC_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'QUA' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS QUA_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'EXEC' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS EXEC_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'MAINT' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS MAINT_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'AGRE' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS AGRE_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN ,MAX(od.DELIVERY_NOTE) AS DELIVERY_NOTE ,MAX(od.TARIFF_REMARKS) AS TARIFF_REMARKS FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_SAS_INVOICE inv ON inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO = cost.AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO
AND cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO, inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO, cost.CUSTOMER_CODE ) A

/* InvoiceMapper.selectPartnerSummaryChargeList : 전자상거래 정산관리 파트너집계 리스트 조회 */
SELECT A.* ,SUM(A.AR_AMOUNT) OVER() AS TOTAL_AR_AMOUNT ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = A.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID_A) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME FROM( SELECT MAX(A.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,MAX(A.INVOICE_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE ,MAX(A.CURRENCY_CODE) AS CURRENCY_CODE ,MAX(A.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(A.BOUND) AS BOUND ,MAX(A.VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,MAX(A.ORIG_CODE) AS ORIG_CODE ,MAX(A.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_CODE ,MAX(A.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(A.ENT_CODE) AS ENT_CODE ,MAX(A.REGISTER_USER_ID_A) AS REGISTER_USER_ID_A ,COUNT(A.OD_JOB_NO) AS HBL_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.CD_TYPE WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS SIMPLE_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.CD_TYPE WHEN 'N' THEN 1 END) AS GENERAL_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.CD_TYPE WHEN 'B' THEN 1 END) AS EXCLUDE_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.INSPECTION_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS INSPECTION_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.SE_INSPECTION_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS SE_INSPECTION_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.XRAY_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS XRAY_CNT ,COUNT(CASE A.DROP_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS DROP_CNT ,SUM(A.PIECES) AS PIECES ,SUM(A.GWT) AS GWT ,SUM(A.WHF_COST) AS WHF_COST ,SUM(A.WHF_COST_CUR) AS WHF_COST_CUR ,SUM(A.WAHA_COST) AS WAHA_COST ,SUM(A.INS_COST) AS INS_COST ,SUM(A.WMAIN_COST) AS WMAIN_COST ,SUM(A.DLC_COST) AS DLC_COST ,SUM(A.DISLA_COST) AS DISLA_COST ,SUM(A.DJU_COST) AS DJU_COST ,SUM(A.DTY_COST) AS DTY_COST ,SUM(A.TAX_COST) AS TAX_COST ,SUM(A.CFC_COST) AS CFC_COST ,SUM(A.QUA_COST) AS QUA_COST ,SUM(A.EXEC_COST) AS EXEC_COST ,SUM(A.MAINT_COST) AS MAINT_COST ,SUM(A.AGRE_COST) AS AGRE_COST ,SUM(A.EXP_COST) AS EXP_COST ,SUM(A.ETC_COST) AS ETC_COST ,SUM(A.AR_AMOUNT) AS AR_AMOUNT FROM( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO ,MAX(cost.CURRENCY_CODE) AS CURRENCY_CODE ,MAX(od.CD_TYPE) AS CD_TYPE ,MAX(od.BOUND) AS BOUND ,MAX(od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,MAX(inv.INVOICE_DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE ,MAX(od.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE
,MAX(od.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(od.VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,MAX(od.ORIG_CODE) AS ORIG_CODE ,MAX(od.INSPECTION_YN) AS INSPECTION_YN ,MAX(ad.SE_INSPECTION_YN) AS SE_INSPECTION_YN ,MAX(ad.XRAY_YN) AS XRAY_YN ,MAX(ad.DROP_YN) AS DROP_YN ,MAX(od.PIECES) AS PIECES ,MAX(od.GWT) AS GWT ,MAX(cost.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_CODE ,MAX(od.ENT_CODE) AS ENT_CODE ,MAX(cost.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_ID_A ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WHF' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS WHF_COST ,MAX(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WHF' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT_CUR, 0) END) AS WHF_COST_CUR ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WAHA' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS WAHA_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'INS' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS INS_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'WMAIN' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS WMAIN_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DLC' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DLC_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DISLA' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DISLA_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DJU' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DJU_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'DTY' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS DTY_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'TAX' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS TAX_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'CFC' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS CFC_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'QUA' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS QUA_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'EXEC' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS EXEC_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'MAINT' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS MAINT_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'AGRE' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS AGRE_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN cost.CHARGE_CODE = 'EXP' THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS EXP_COST ,SUM(CASE WHEN chg.CHG_CODE_SYSTEM IN('JOB_E','WHC_E','DLV_E','BRK_E') THEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) END) AS ETC_COST ,ISNULL(SUM(cost.AR_AMOUNT), 0) AS AR_AMOUNT
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_SAS_INVOICE inv ON inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO = cost.AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO
AND cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY inv.INVOICE_JOB_NO, od.OD_JOB_NO, cost.CUSTOMER_CODE ) A GROUP BY A.INVOICE_JOB_NO, A.MBL_NO, A.CUSTOMER_CODE ) A

/* InvoiceMapper.selectOdCostSum : 전자상거래 정산서생성 OD_COST 조회 */ SELECT cost.CHARGE_CODE ,MAX(cost.CURRENCY_CODE) AS CURRENCY_CODE ,MAX(cost.CHARGE_NAME) AS CHARGE_NAME ,ISNULL(SUM(cost.${srchArAp}_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT ,MAX(od.OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO ,CASE WHEN MAX(od.BOUND_TYPE) = 'EXP' THEN MAX(od.OB_DATE) ELSE MAX(od.AR_DATE) END AS OBAR_DATE ,MAX(od.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO
,ISNULL(SUM(cost.AR_AMOUNT_CUR), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT_CUR
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE
GROUP BY cost.CURRENCY_CODE, cost.CHARGE_CODE ORDER BY CURRENCY_CODE
GROUP BY cost.CHARGE_CODE

/* InvoiceMapper.selectOdCostSumSelectGrid : 전자상거래 정산서생성 OD_COST 조회 */ SELECT cost.CHARGE_CODE ,MAX(cost.CURRENCY_CODE) AS CURRENCY_CODE ,MAX(cost.CHARGE_NAME) AS CHARGE_NAME ,ISNULL(SUM(cost.${arAp}_AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT ,MAX(od.OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO ,CASE WHEN MAX(od.BOUND_TYPE) = 'EXP' THEN MAX(od.OB_DATE) ELSE MAX(od.AR_DATE) END AS OBAR_DATE ,MAX(od.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO
,ISNULL(SUM(cost.AR_AMOUNT_CUR), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT_CUR
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE
AND od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
GROUP BY cost.CURRENCY_CODE, cost.CHARGE_CODE ORDER BY CURRENCY_CODE
GROUP BY cost.CHARGE_CODE
mapper.update:
/* InvoiceMapper.updateOdCostSelectGrid : 전자상거래 정산서생성 TB_ECM_OD_COST update */ UPDATE cost SET ${arAp}_INVOICE_JOB_NO = #{invoiceJobNo} ,${arAp}_INVOICE_DATE = CONVERT(DATE, #{invoiceDate}, ${dateFormat})
,cost.AR_AMOUNT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(cost.AR_AMOUNT, 0) = 0 AND cost.AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO IS NULL THEN cost.AP_AMOUNT ELSE cost.AR_AMOUNT END
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE
AND od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
mapper.insert: /* InvoiceMapper.insertObl : 전자상거래 일반정산 정산서생성 TB_COM_OBL insert */ INSERT INTO TB_COM_OBL ( OBL_JOB_NO ,ENT_CODE ,SOLUTION ,BOUND ,BL_TYPE_MH ,MBL_NO ,HBL_NO ,SHIPPER_NAME ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D ,CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D ,ITEM_NAME ,LINE_CODE ,LINE_NAME ,VESSEL_FLIGHT ,VESSEL_VOYAGE ,ORIG_CODE ,ORIG_NAME ,DEST_CODE ,DEST_NAME ,OB_DATE ,OB_TIME ,AR_DATE ,AR_TIME ,INCOTERMS ,PIECES ,UNIT_PIECES ,GWT ,LBS_GWT ,REGISTER_USER_ID ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,UPDATE_USER_ID ,UPDATE_DATE_TIME ) SELECT #{oblJobNo} AS OBL_JOB_NO ,ENT_CODE ,SOLUTION ,BOUND ,BL_TYPE_MH ,MBL_NO ,HBL_NO ,SHIPPER_NAME ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C ,SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D ,CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C ,CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D ,SUBSTRING(COMMODITY_ITEM, 1, 100) ,LINE_CODE ,LINE_NAME ,VESSEL_FLIGHT ,VOYAGE AS VESSEL_VOYAGE ,ORIG_CODE ,ORIG_NAME ,DEST_CODE ,DEST_NAME ,OB_DATE ,OB_TIME ,AR_DATE ,AR_TIME ,INCOTERMS ,PIECES ,UNIT_PIECES ,GWT ,GWT_LBS AS LBS_GWT ,#{userId} AS REGISTER_USER_ID ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) AS REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,#{updateUserId} AS UPDATE_USER_ID ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) AS UPDATE_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{ecmOdJobNo}
mapper.update:
/* InvoiceMapper.updateWorkFeeCloseSelectGrid : 전자상거래 작업료마감 */ UPDATE cost SET cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO = #{invoiceJobNo} ,cost.AP_INVOICE_DATE = CASE WHEN #{invoiceJobNo} IS NOT NULL THEN GETDATE() ELSE NULL END FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_COST cost ON cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE
AND od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
AND cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO IS NOT NULL
AND cost.AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO IS NULL

/* InvoiceMapper.deleteOrderCost : 추가비용 삭제 */ DELETE FROM cost FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST cost INNER JOIN TB_SMS_CHARGE chg ON chg.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND chg.CHARGE_CODE = cost.CHARGE_CODE WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item}) AND AR_INVOICE_JOB_NO IS NULL AND AP_INVOICE_JOB_NO IS NULL AND chg.CHG_CODE_SYSTEM LIKE CONCAT(#{invoiceType}, '%')
mapper.select:
/* InvoiceMapper.selectCustomerTreeList : 하위업체 조회 */ WITH tree_query AS ( SELECT cus.CUSTOMER_CODE , cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL AS CUSTOMER_LV FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus WHERE cus.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND cus.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE = #{customerCode} UNION ALL SELECT B.CUSTOMER_CODE , B.CUSTOMER_LEVEL AS CUSTOMER_LV FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER B, tree_query C WHERE B.PARENT_CUSTOMER_CODE = C.CUSTOMER_CODE )
SELECT A.* FROM tree_query A
